spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (कोकते)
To take, to accept.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Taking, accepting.
E.
कुक and क aff.

n. (-भं)
Spirituous liquor.

mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
1 Having a crooked or withered arm.
2 Wicked, acting wickedly.
E.
कु bad, and कर the hand; or कृ to do, ट aff.

mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म)
Wicked, bad.
n. (-र्म्म)
Wickedness, depravity, villainy.
E.
कु bad, कर्म्मन् act.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Wicked, depraved.
E.
कुकर्म्म, and कारिन् who does.

m. (-लः)
A mountain.
E.
कु earth, and कील a pin or bolt.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
One who gives a girl, decorated with fit ornaments and with the prescribed ceremonies, in marriage.
E.
कुक to take, and द who gives: see कूकुद.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
One who gives a girl in marriage with due ceremony, and suitable decorations.
E.
कुक to take, deriv. irr.

n. (-रं) or n. du. (-रे)
The cavities of the loins.
E.
कुन्दर a hollow, a cave, from कु the earth, and दृ to rend or tear, कु bad, vile, prefixed; it is also written ककुन्दर.

f. (-भा)
One of the female personifications of music or Rāgiṇīs.

m. (-भः)
1 A wild cock, (Phasianus gallus.)
2 Varnish, oiling or oily gloss; also कुक्कुभक. m. (-कः)
E.
कुक् imitative sound, कु to utter sound, and भक् irr. aff.

m. (-रः)
1 A dog.
2 A branch of the Yadu race: see कुक्कुर.
3 A plant and perfume: see ग्रन्थपर्णी.
m. plu. (-राः)
A country: see दशार्ह.
E.
कुक to take, उरच् Uṇādi affix; also कुक्कुर.

m. (-रः)
A dog.
n. (-रं)
A vegetable perfume, commonly Ganṭhiāla: see ग्रंथिपर्णी.
f. (-री)
A bitch.
E.
कुक to take, उरन् Uṇādi affix, and क inserted; also कुकुर.

m. (-थः)
KṚṢṆA.
E.
कुकुर a Yadu, and अधिनाथ chief.

m. (-कः)
Weakness of the eyes in infants.

n. (-लं)
A hole filled with stakes.
2 Conflagration of chaff.
3 Armour, mail.
E.
कु the earth, and कूल a bank, &c.

n. (-त्यं)
Wickedness, evil.
E.
कु, and कृत्य act.

n. (-लं)
The jujube: see कोलि.

m. (-टः)
1 A cock.
2 A wild cock.
3 The offspring of a Śūdra or man of the fourth caste, by a Caṇḍāla woman.
4 A whisp of lighted straw, a firebrand.
5 A spark of fire.
f. (-टिः or -टी)
Hypocrisy, interested observance of religious duties.
f. (-टी)
1 A hen.
2 A small house lizard.
3 The silk cotton tree, (Bombax heptaphyllum.)
E.
कुक् taking, from कुक with क्विप् affix, and कुट to cut or scratch, with क affix; scratching up the earth, &c. or कु bad, कुट to cut, &c. and क inserted.

m. (-कः)
1 A cock.
2 A wild cock.
3 A man of a mixed caste, one sprung from a Śūdra and the female of a barbarian.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

m. (-पः)
A place where final emancipation may be attained; also मुक्तिमण्डप.

n. (-कं)
A sort of pepper, (Piper chavya.)
E.
कुक्कुट, and मस्तक head; to what the flower may be compared.

n. (-तं)
A religious observation, (worship of ŚIVA,) on the seventh of the light fortnight of Bhadra, by women, especially [] for the sake of obtaining offspring.
E.
कुक्कुट a fowl, and व्रत religious rite; alluding to the fruitfulness of the hen.

m. (-खः)
Safflower, (Carthamus tinctorius.)
E.
कुक्कुट a cock, and शिख a crest; cockscomb.

n. (-ण्डं)
A fowl's egg.
E.
कुक्कुटी, and अण्ड an egg.

m. (-भः)
A kind of snake, compared to a fowl, in some respects, perhaps from having a crest or comb.
E.
कुक्कुट a cock, and आभ who is or resembles, from भा to shine, prefix आङ् and affix क.

m. (-हिः)
A kind of snake: see the preceding.

m. (-क्)
A sort of deer.

m. (-क्षः)
The belly.
E.
कुष to extract, and सः affix; by which the foeces are excreted; also कुक्षि.

m. (-क्षिः)
The belly, the cavity of the abdomen.
E.
कुषि to extract, and क्मि affix; see the preceding.

mfn. (-रिः-रिः-रि)
Voracious, gluttonous, filling or pampering the belly.
E.
कुक्षि the belly, भृ to nourish, affix स्वि.

m. (-न्ध्रः)
A reed.
E.
कुक्षि, and रब्ध्र a hole.
